entries.text: TPC-DS maintenance operation timings now cover only the operation itself: the connection is opened and dimension ranges are initialized before the interval starts, and the connection closes after it ends. Maintenance timings from earlier versions include connection setup and initialization and are not comparable with new ones.

TPC-DS maintenance row generation is now reproducible. The synthetic row generator is seeded from a value in the maintenance test configuration (default fixed) instead of the wall clock, the sales rows chosen for returns are ordered by a seeded integer key instead of database randomness, the seed is recorded in the maintenance test result, and maintenance durations use a monotonic clock.
